reviews.text: Amazing oracle deck app!. I’d never been heard of an app before for oracle decks until friend shared this app with me. It’s been amazing to sample various decks without fully buying them. Totally recommend this app!!!

Great until…. *update the developer reached out to me and explained that the newer Oracle decks that they’ve acquired do not allow you to have them as a standalone item on your home screen. Have to open their icon, tap on my Library, tap on the app-my other purchased apps show as well-and open it. It’s more steps, and I probably won’t be purchasing more decks that are like that from them. But I appreciate the response from the developer and the assistance. I would purchase more standalone deck from them.

I purchased two Oracle decks from this app and they’ve been great. They download on my phone I up can just click on them and open them. But now I’ve purchased the Mystic shaman and it’s not on my phone I have to search in the apps for a beauty everywhere, and then open that and then go to my library and then look for the Mystic shaman. I want a refund.

All my other pre-existing BE apps are in the library but the Mystical Shaman Oracle is not, despite being one of the apps for sale in the umbrella app. When I clicked on it I was offered a free trial! I emailed customer service a week ago and didn’t get a response. I tried contacting Apple for assistance which also went nowhere. I paid $14.99 for an app that no longer opens.

Crashing. The app keeps crashing about five seconds after I open it every time. I have tried about 10 times and I’m giving up this morning. Not usable. most of the decks I have purchased are only on this app. This is very frustrating that I can’t use what I’ve bought.

App is great when I can get it to work. Ever since iOS 17, the app has begun locking up at any time between start and long enough to click library, click open on a deck and actually work your way to selecting the first card. Then it freezes.

Restarting the entire phone might let you get 2-3 pulls. This seems to be a memory leak, probably related to all the crash protection. 

Please address it soon as I’m sitting on near 50 USD of decks I can’t use, not to mention saved readings.
Disappointed. iOS update now can’t open any decks app keeps freezing up.

Tarot?. I like that everything is all in one place. However, I bought the “Good Tarot” app and it just has oracle spreads (one, two, and three card spreads). Not even a Celtic Cross option? The other Tarot deck I have has a Celtic Cross spread, so it’s obviously possible. Tarot cards need at least some actual TAROT spreads.

Great cards, annoying interface. The cards that are available here deserve five stars, but the interface is clunky and annoying. The tiny little window to read the card meaning is especially irritating. The Hay House apps were much better designed, and most card meaning text fit on a single screen. Why Oceanhouse Media/BE insists on this terrible format where you have to scroll through a tiny window, which makes me wish for a magnifying glass and the full screen real estate, is beyond me. I imagine they think it looks “sophisticated,” but it’s really just irritating for the user, as others have noted here as well. Fix it, and I’ll revise my rating, but until then, two stars it is.

For those who are wondering about decks previously purchased from Hay House, if you contact BE with a screenshot of your purchase, they’ll send you a code to access it in this app for free.

reviews.text: No support. No responses to emails.. One would expect more from spiritual apps. Constantly crashing then not able to even open it after their recent update. If you raise it with apple, apple forwards you their message asking you to contact them by…. email and to check your spam folder. Trust me I did check it: nothing, zero, nichts there either. Pathetic. Lack of integrity. Commodification of spirituality under a false pretense: buy and we are done. Thank you but no, thank you

angry and want answers. a lot of these apps used to exist outside of this app previously. i know. i’d purchased them before. and after several months, i would sometimes delete them from my library. then the apps started to be removed from the store. imagine my surprise to find them all reused here in this app… i’d previously purchased SEVERAL of these when they were solo apps years ago through hay house. i had QUITE a few from NBR, including the animal, goddess, and wisdom. that’s a minimum of 30 bucks right there. so the question is… will i have to RE-purchase them? if so… no. or i want refunds on previously purchased apps. did anyone else on here NOT realize this? that many of these already previously existed?

Portability. I love the portability of this App. My favorite decks are easily accessible wherever I am. It’s genius plus their offering of other decks to purchase at a reasonable price is awesome. Their free 2 day trial ensures whether or not I am drawn to the deck before purchasing. Thank you!

Great app. This has been a great app! I love that it consolidates all the decks into ine aoo. You can also fet a trial of a ton of decks which lets me know if i want to buy them or not! They iften have 50% off decks and that makes them only $5! The inly thing I would like that isn’t i cluded is a feature where the card description is read out loud to you.

Convenient yet needs reversed card positions. It’s very convenient to be able to read decks without carrying them!! One part that I want to have is to receive “Reversed positions” in each cards, as some decks’ change meaning depending on each cards are straight up or upside down.

You Can’t Opt Out of Reversed Cards. I downloaded this app because I saw some decks by familiar authors that I like. Generally, it’s okay, but the interface is clunky on the iPhone and there’s no way to contact support if you need to, which I did because not everything works as it should. For one thing, when you tap the contact support button it brings up a message window all of a sliver being off-screen so there’s no way to type or send the message. 

On the deck I purchased, the scroll animation broke after the first use and is now rather ugly, if still useable. One thing I really don’t like, though, is that there’s no way to opt out of reversed card readings. I don’t read using reversals in tarot or oracle cards. Hence, I’ve stopped using this app for the most part.

Frustrating. I can’t get the card decks to go to my Home Screen and they won’t return my money for the purchases

Slow and Buggy. Literally a 2 to 3 second lag when trying to do anything in this app, including scrolling down, makes it impossible to use. I have more than 75 Oracle card apps, and I like being able to arrange them how I want on my screens because I want super fast access to my most often used ones. It takes at least 30 seconds to a minute to find the app I want and begin a reading in this app. And one of the only decks I’ve purchased from this app is now asking me to re-purchase… and it gets stuck on the settings screen where I click “restore purchases” and nothing happens. It’s also incredibly annoying that when I’m using their other apps, it might advertise a new app and if I click on the pop-up, it takes me to the Be Oracle app in the App Store and sometimes I can’t find the Oracle deck mentioned, or it takes several minutes of hunting around to find it. This new system is not working at all for user experience. I will not be purchasing any more Oracle apps from this company until there’s the option to use them as I previously did, with each deck being its own app.

Awful experience. Installed app and bought first oracle deck which worked one time. Now the app just closes every time I try to run. Check contact and support tab and that was not helpful at all. Tried the rate this app tab and that didn’t even work.
Love this app. All my favorite Oracle decks & Tarot Decks in one place. No need to choose which deck to travel with. Of course, unless it’s the latest published and not yet placed in this app.
App crashes. I just purchased this now it won't open. Help

Bugs to work out. There are a lot of issues with loading decks which leads to having to close out of the app and restart. Also, today my phone Lock Screen went on and the reading I was in the middle of completely disappeared, it would be helpful if it saved where one is at incase one needs to set the phone down briefly

Unusable. I was so excited to have them all in one app. This company keeps breaking apps and rereleasing them and it’s exhausting to keep up with. Love the idea but this app is constantly hung up or crashing. It also doesn’t keep your purchases unless you keep them downloaded on your phone and in the app yet the new ones you can’t have a separate app when this one doesn’t work. It’s a really expensive mess for those of us that have all the apps. I can’t even get them all to download as it’s so unstable.

Frustrating!. I came in here to purchase an app I was looking for and it could not be found. The link from their website, from the deck I wanted, led me to the app and then it was not found. I tried to browse other decks available but every deck I clicked on was linked to the wrong deck. I finally figured out it was three off. So if I saw a deck I wanted to explore, I had to scroll three decks away to access the one I wanted. Frustrating quirk. Browsing samples of the deck was ok but hard to read sometimes and didn’t see access to reviews. As for the deck apps themselves, they are Ok but preferred the old designs that used to be available thru, was it Oceanhouse Media or Hay House?. I really don’t like the very small window to read and scroll through the card descriptions. For me, when I try to share a reading, emailing to myself, only a small part of the description is sent, leaving out the bulk of the description. I contacted customer support about it. They asked me about what version of iPhone I have and then never heard another word. I love to utilize digital decks when doing professional readings but doesn’t really lend well for that anymore. Such a bummer :-(

Super slow & buggy. Also a lot of my decks are no longer appearing in my library, even when I attempt to restore my purchases. They were $10 each and don’t even appear to be used! This needs to be fixed!

Ineffective. I have 5 BE apps so far, and the library app did not load my Les Vampires app into the library. When I reported the bug, they asked for evidence. It was bought several years ago, and I no longer have the receipt for it. This problem taints my impression of the library so badly, that I deem it useless.

Love the concept. But…... I really think this will be a great app, once there’s some work done to it. For now, I am not really enjoying it at all. I have purchased almost all of the oracle apps and I LOVE them! However, this app keeps freezing and it gets annoying trying to do a reading. Most of the oracle apps I purchased was before this app was created. When I purchased them, I of course received a shortcut link button(? I don’t know what to call it) for each oracle app. Since this app was launched, I have purchased 2 or 3 more apps and I did not receive a short cut to get to them, which stinks. Because you have to purchase all their decks now from this app and with it freezing all the time I don’t think I’ll be buying anymore. Not until they either fix the issues with the app or give back a short cut button to get in each of the oracle apps. I have had no problems with any of my oracle apps freezing until now. Also, not that it matters at present, but there are still 6 of my apps I previously purchased not showing I own in this app. I don’t know how that can be fixed because it’s asking me to repurchase them. I was going to delete the app and reinstall but it says if I delete it, all my information will be erased and I don’t want to lose the card readings I have saved in the app. This app has potential. But I would still like my own shortcut links to the decks I purchase. Because if I want to do a reading and this app crashes then I can’t use my decks.

Love the easy access - bugs fixed!. I love having ready and easy access to so many of my Oracle card decks in one place! Initially, the app had some bugs where readings from one deck bled into the next deck, but that seems to have been fixed now. I’m so glad, because I love these decks (I have over 20 now) and they never grow old.I love being exposed to new ones, which I purchase when drawn to. Each one is unique, precious and powerful in their own way and this app smoothly and efficiently delivers! Well done!
All my favorites in 1 app!. Love this new app! Easy to access all of my favorite Oracle and tarot decks!
At last. At last it works! Well done.
Practical and available anywhere. I enjoyed pulling cards on the go, without having to have a real card in my hands.

Good idea. Choppy interface. I really like the idea of this app. I just wish the animations were smooth and it didn’t keep stalling. I have a very fast new iPhone and I have recently reset it and recently reinstalled this app. With a little bit of optimisation this could be my favourite app on my phone.

Great app. Great little app for on the go reading or anytime really. Although I miss having an actual deck in my hands to feel I can see and read these so much clearer than on a card or guidebook as I’ve poor eyesight. 
Also I’d say I’ve found them more accurate reading on the app. 
Price is also nearly half for the decks. 
All round I’d give it five stars.
Sad. Extremely poor app, hangs and crashes every second. Not user friendly at all. Spent £9 pounds for a deck I love but it is a waste as I can’t use it at all.

Avoid. This app from the former Hay House collaborator is a disappointing copycat. Unlike the beautiful decks (you’d be better off buying the physical decks if you’re not pressed for space), the app is not functional, and keeps crashing. Not only dies it NOT offer a free trial like the The Hay House and similar developers do, so you can get a feel of the deck, the screenshots aren’t reflecting the actual decks , only the selection on offer, so unless you know the deck or look it up on the internet, you’re buying a cat in the bag, in addition the app
 does not allow to restore previous purchases. These tech glitches, teamed with the human aspect of unhelpful & condescending tech/customer support (yes, I do know how to use my phone, clear the cache and the cookies and reinstall the apps - it’s your app that’s glitches) make for a very awkward space waster on your phone. The individual apps used to work better. Avoid
Keeps Crashing.. Not managed to actually use this app as it keeps falling over!

Be advised. Rating: 1/5
I had high hopes when I downloaded this app, but my experience has been nothing but frustrating. The app keeps crashing every time I try to use it, making it completely inaccessible. To make matters worse, I’ve reached out to their support team multiple times, but no one has responded. It’s extremely disappointing to purchase something and then be unable to use it or get any help. I cannot recommend this app until these issues are resolved.
All in one spot. It’s nice to have all your fav oracles apps in one spot :)
Fix It Please !. Kindly fix it so it works properly .

App Keeps freezing. It was working really well and about 6moths ago. Now it keeps freezing or locking up on me within in secs of opening up the app. I have to hard close the app to get out. I have 14promax and I have checked for updates but all is updated. I have reached out to ocean house media today. Will update if issue gets resolved. I would give a 5 star before this issue

App keep’s crashing. It is a lovely offering. But I can not access my purchases every now and then as the app freezes

I have re-installed several times and the issue persists

There are a few interesting decks I would like to purchase but I am concerned I won’t be able to use them properly
This is terrible. The apps wont open once purchased and keep saying to update.. and I cannot find a place to ask for a refund!

App troubles - eventually rectified. I happily paid for The Shaman’s Dream from Colette Baron Reid and was very disappointed to find after a few readings that one of the cards (Deep Diver) had the same message as Dances on One Foot. I contacted the app (Oceanhouse) and was told that an update would fix it in a few days. It’s been over a week with no update showing up on my iPhone and now the app won’t even open. Once I click on the deck the title page appears and then the app closes. No answer to my questions about a refund.

UPDATE Nov. 30
Apple was great about issuing refund and after I left this review I was contacted by Oceanhouse. They finally did the update and once I deleted and reinstalled the app, all works well now.
Love it. GREAT APP!!!

I hate this app. I seriously dislike the way I have to go into this app in order to use my cards.

When I go back into the app, I have to hunt again for the cards that I like to use.

The app never remembers which card I had open. Other apps that I use will remember which card I had open the last time I used it,

I wish all of the cards were in their own app.

Great idea but would be nice to have digital access to the guide book of cards physically owned. I own a few of the cards that are in this app and bought most via amazon. I would like to suggest that instead of charging people to have digital access to the cards physically that this should be a bonus with the purchase. Or if not on purchase there is a link or qr code scan to download possibly a pdf file of the guide book when on the go and only bringing the cards. The app itself has a good concept but the UI and response speed needs to be improved.

Big mistake buying. Just buy cards individually if you want oracle cards. It’s way better. This app is terrible to use compared to owning individual card decks. Not user friendly at all. 
It defaults to the page to make you buy more cards when it should automatically default to your library. (If you were designing this with users in mind). 
Then when you use your library there are more steps to actually get to your oracle cards. It’s is not easy and now I have like 3 decks stuck in this library that I can’t get to use like my other oracle decks. 
I totally regret buying cards through this app. I have decks already and wish I just stayed buying individually. Purchase cards wisely. Don’t make my mistake.

Unfortunate. Continues to amaze me how poorly made the app is. As a software developer, I can’t imagine how this was passed through for publishing. The artists who make the decks do great work but they are severely let down by this app. Please fix the continual crashing and freezing, especially on iPad. Much of the content is also off the screen most of the time.
Two minds. Love the deck, but like all BEAUT EVERYWHERE apps, it’s disappointing that the information is in small amounts to scroll through, and in full view like other publishers…

Disappointed. This app looks great but the user experience is disappointing. This app is so buggy with constant drop outs and paid purchases are not accessible outside the app. Please fix these issues.

App quits constantly. App quits constantly mid reading causing you to lose your cards. Quits every 20 seconds or so. Unusable. Some of these decks are not available as stand alone apps so it’s disappointing to pay for something you are unable to use due to bugs.
